scope: Independent read-only review of the complete remaining-wallet-report batch and neighbouring source contracts. This is a focused iteration review, not execution of application tests, a full Gate A acceptance, or genuine complete-wallet B3 acceptance.

review_execution.generated_assets_scope: Index reference and exact committed bytes checked; production build is a separate producer, no independent pixel or compiled-code semantic claim.

corrected_findings.issue: Gross asset activity was hidden by cancelling endpoint quantities
corrected_findings.correction: Original positive transfers and supported mint/burn operations touching the owned account now preserve activity; ordinary unchanged endpoints remain independently usable. Nonsettlement activity remains unclassified without historical meme/nonspam sources.

corrected_findings.issue: All proved-outside selected records lacked a supported scoped zero and its exclusion evidence
corrected_findings.correction: Retain each independent outside-interval placement and its original evidence. A complete selected source set can produce scoped zero without claiming a complete wallet population.

corrected_findings.issue: Missing or null wallet-touching CPI recording could be mistaken for recorded empty transfers
corrected_findings.correction: Unrecorded relevant CPI leaves gross transfers UNKNOWN. Explicit empty recording, inherently non-CPI builtins, failed execution and proved disjoint instructions retain their narrower supported facts.

corrected_findings.issue: Initial native selector capture could exceed the budget enforced by its own saved replay
corrected_findings.correction: Canonical selector hashes and the complete inspected source/selector union are bounded before selector archive writes; saved consumption uses the same union, including inspected nested hashes. Selectors never expand authenticated collector roles.

corrected_findings.issue: Cash and inventory amounts could render from PASS checks without usable source references
corrected_findings.correction: Amount-bearing checks and inventory points require nonempty arrays of valid SHA256 references. Same-slot inventory also requires references; valid source buttons remain inspectable when mixed references make amounts UNKNOWN.
corrected_findings.regression: frontend/scripts/check-discovery.mjs source-reference and point-loss/restoration SSR assertions

corrected_findings.issue: Outside-interval cash exclusion could bypass an unresolved frozen source inventory
corrected_findings.correction: The exclusion branch independently requires source_set PASS and retains both source-set and exclusion evidence. An unreadable unassignable link now revokes the zero while unrelated outside-window transfer/fee decoding is not required.
corrected_findings.regression: Existing all-proved-outside native-cash node includes unassignable source-loss assertions

corrected_findings.issue: Inventory freshness could treat missing methods as equal or ignore a stale wallet assessment
corrected_findings.correction: Inventory requires a nonempty current method, matching saved wallet version and current saved/current wallet assessment methodology, alongside history freshness. Original values and source buttons are preserved.
corrected_findings.regression: frontend/scripts/check-discovery.mjs missing method/version, missing saved_methodology and rebuild_required SSR assertions

reviewed_contracts: Native capture shares the pinned allowlist, reservation/dispatch/settlement, quotas, retries and error handling; retained body bytes exclude request URLs and headers. Legacy snapshots do not acquire fabricated byte evidence.

Separately frozen selector metadata is bound to exact immutable saved-report input, address/window and report; missing originals cannot be promoted by negative affinities and child reports preserve collector/checkpoint references.

Asset identity and activity use original selected and linked native representations, with independent report/28/90 membership and frozen source inventory. Current mint authorities/extensions are observations, not historical meme/nonspam eligibility.

Gross native transfer directions, linked alternatives, execution and interval placement remain distinct from network fees, economic roles and complete owned-account movements. Equal incoming/outgoing movement is preserved.

Native/token phase observations and protocol WSOL denomination remain separate from complete historical boundaries and marks. Account/rent lamports are not added to token units. Partial zero external flows leave economic_inputs empty and cannot supply equity.

Normal native/archive saved reports, import/rebuild/export and independent metric gates share the new adapters. The synthetic finite-world override remains explicitly development-only; genuine uploaded valuation flags cannot supply these economic inputs.

Native cash exact amounts use bounded integer text and BigInt; interval/method/assessment/source guards hide unsupported amounts while preserving source inspection. Wallet v9/archive v12 and CAP documentation describe partial observations and remaining gaps accurately.

selector_source_inspection.method: AST literal inspection only; no pytest collection or execution

remaining_CAP_source_gaps.remaining: Legacy snapshots lack original RPC bytes; current independent slots do not supply historical all-account report/28/90 boundaries.
Gross wallet-address System transfers do not establish payment/tip/capital roles, complete owned-account movement or complete cost/valued-flow population.
Accepted time-relevant meme identity and nonspam evidence for nonsettlement assets remain absent; current controls and mint suffixes are insufficient.
Exact all-account historical opening/closing inventory, nonsettlement historical marks and complete valued-flow roles remain unresolved; no genuine complete economic inputs are emitted.

Exhaustive historical ownership/record and acquisition coverage, complete real accounting and independently worked whole-wallet genuine acceptance remain open or blocked. No paid/live collection, new release ZIP or whole-product acceptance is claimed.

prior_review_observations_preserved.note: These earlier observations are not relabelled as the corrected current source. Final owner checks are a separate producer; repeated assertions/commands are not added to unique test counts.
